# Patio Productions

> > Premium outdoor furniture retailer specializing in POLYWOOD recycled plastic furniture, teak collections, and weather-resistant patio solutions from brands like Sunset West and Harmonia.

Patio Productions offers a curated selection of high-end outdoor furniture featuring sustainable materials like HDPE (High Density Polyethylene) recycled plastic and premium teak, with custom cushioning options in Sunbrella and Revolution fabrics. The retailer focuses on durable, weather-resistant furniture collections designed for coastal and outdoor living.

## Key Topics

- POLYWOOD recycled plastic furniture
- HDPE (High Density Polyethylene) lumber
- Teak outdoor furniture
- Sunbrella fabric cushions
- Revolution fabric
- Sunset West collections
- Weather-resistant patio furniture
- Coastal outdoor living
- Modular sectional seating
- Harmonia Living
- Marine-grade materials
- Sustainable outdoor furniture
- Chaise lounges and ottomans
- Outdoor dining tables
- Counter and bar height seating
